english.title: Transporter fail to comply with EU regulation regarding transport of animals in Wales

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Welfare of Animals Transport Wales Order 2007

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a transporter of animals from **(..SPECIFY PLACE OF DEPARTURE..) to **(..SPECIFY DESTINATION..), without lawful authority or excuse failed to comply with Article 6(2), (3), (4), (6) and (8) of Council Regulation (EC) No 1/2005 relating to transporters in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 6(c) of the Welfare of Animals (Transport) (Wales) Order 2007, sections 73 and 75 of the Animal Health Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a transporter of animals
without lawful authority or excuse failed to
notify to the competent authority any changes in relation to the information and documents referred to in Article 10(1) no more than 15 working days from the date the changes took place OR
for long journeys, notify to the competent authority any changes in relation to the information and documents referred to in Article 11(1), no more than 15 working days from the date the changes took place OR
transport the animals in accordance with the technical rules set out in Annex I OR
entrust the handling of the animals to personnel who had received training on the relevant provisions of Annexes I and II OR
ensure that an attendant accompanied the consignment of animals OR
make available the certificate of approval as provided for in Article 18(2) or Article 19(2) to the competent authority of the country to which animals were transported

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
